workflow.title: Diff CRM contacts missing from newsletter list (report only)
workflow.goal: Read the CRM sheet and the newsletter list, skip CRM contacts marked unsubscribed, and report which remaining CRM contacts are not in the newsletter list. Make no changes to any sheet and send nothing. Unsubscribed contacts are left alone entirely.

assumptions: The crm sheet is the Mindbody contact export with email, name, company, tags, unsubscribed.
The newsletter sheet stands in for the Mailchimp audience.
Emails are matched ignoring case and spaces, as rows.reconcile does.
Unsubscribed CRM contacts are left out of the diff entirely and never added.
risks: Sheet exports may contain duplicate or malformed emails that are reported as-is.
The report is a snapshot; it does not add anyone to the newsletter list. The user reviews the list before any manual action.
successCriteria: Every reported contact is in crm, has unsubscribed not true, and is absent from the newsletter sheet.
No rows are appended to the crm or newsletter sheets and no message is sent (verified by sheet.audit with zero appends).
A diff artifact is written for review.
